description: Born before the dawn of creation, Iternity commands the forces of Light, Shadow, Undead, and Psychic. As sovereign of the four ancient guardians, it maintains the balance between life, death, and consciousness. Legends say Iternity and Cosmosis together preserve the very fabric of Ele.

Mors, the Guardian of the Undead, is one of Ele's four ancient guardians and the eternal opposite of Gos, presiding over the forgotten souls that linger between life and death. Where Gos preserves the memories of the living, Mors commands the echoes of the departed.

Penitence, the Guardian of Shadow, is one of Ele's four ancient guardians and the eternal counterpart to Patience, embodying the darkness that has existed since the first light was born. Said to dwell within the shadows of every living soul, Penitence bears witness to the secrets, regrets, and sins that even time cannot erase.

Patience, the Guardian of Light, is one of Ele's four ancient guardians, embodying the eternal radiance that holds darkness at bay. Said to have witnessed the first dawn, Patience has watched over countless civilizations, offering guidance only when their hope begins to fade.

Ancient legends speak of a sacred Dracosleaf that stood watch over Ele's oldest forests until a mysterious poison seeped deep into the earth. Reborn as Toxsleaf, its once-life-giving power now spreads a creeping blight that consumes entire forests,
Uncommon step on the Undead stand-in evolve path.
An undead placeholder Siegeling. Full Undead roster coming soon.
Rare capstone of the Undead stand-in line.
A mind-touched placeholder Siegeling. Full Psychic roster coming soon.
An ancient horror from the space between worlds. Extremely rare and dangerous.

Gos, the Many-Faced Guardian, is one of Ele's four ancient guardians, embodying the boundless power of the mind and standing as the eternal opposite of Mors. Its countless faces are said to hold the memories and wisdom of every soul that has ever lived, allowing it to glimpse truths hidden beyond time itself.

Zeel appears only during fierce electric storms, weaving through thunderclouds with its twin tails. Ancient legends claim one tail holds the sky’s first lightning, while the other carries the earth’s answering spark. When they meet, entire skies fall silent before a thunderclap that shakes Ele.
Bearzooka struts accross the molten scape sending fireballs at prey and predator
The bearnade controls its eruptions with a timed fuze, they are famous for their 5 second warnings!
The bearby walks the flame lands solo. Beware startling one can be explosive!
The peaceful applehead, often found sleeping at the base of orchard trees. Its fruit can heal terrible wounds.
Despite its adorable appearance, Cacty is anything but harmless. Its thick, razor-sharp thorns inflict agonizing wounds on anything that gets too close.
The elusive trickster pylme, social creatures often found pranking others with discarded banana peels
The sneaky sleaf, leaf creatures found slithering in piles of fallen autumn leaves where they spawn every fall.
The SquireBud phalanx is the foundation of forest defense. Led by a floraknight these Siegelings are loyal with everything to prove.
Bonoblades lurk in the treetops, leaping from the canopy striking unsuspecting passerby’s, when in the forest.. look up!
Flora Knights are the rank officers leading the SquireBud legions, each battalion reporting to a proven Generoot, the guardian of the forest.
After evolving, Jacked’ty grows muscular cactus arms capable of devastating blows. Its punches are so powerful they can rupture heavy punching bags with ease.

Mossy, the Earth Eleminion, serves as the guardian and bridge between humans and Earth Siegelings. Its unmatched healing powers can restore even the most grievous wounds, bringing life back to forests and companions alike. Wherever Mossy walks, flowers bloom, the land flourishes, and harmony follows.
CactyJacked’ty outgrows its pot, gaining towering limbs and unmatched reach. Its thorn barrages become deadly accurate, striking enemies from afar.
In spring, Dracosleaf reveals its draconic form. By summer, it sheds its leafy tail-tip, which incubates into a new generation of Sleafs.
Leader of the Flora Knight Battalions, Generoot defends the forest with immense strength and a living floral blade. Few invaders survive its challenge.
Masters of forest ambushes, Guerillas lead Bonoblades and Pylme Tricksters in swift canopy assaults. Their tactics inspired the name guerrilla warfare.
It spends the cold season hidden underground with only its leafy plumage exposed. Forest folk warn that stepping into an unusually colorful leaf pile may awaken a hungry Sleafwyrm.

Many believe Gymstone is the living soul of the mountain itself. Forged from ancient stone and eternal crystal, it slumbers beneath the earth for ages, awakening only when the mountain calls upon its guardian.
A tortoise whose shell crackles with stored static. It shocks anything that touches it, but never initiates conflict.
A tiny orb of crackling electricity. It panics when approached, discharging sparks in every direction as it flees.
Electrified ants that march in formation. Their synchronized shocks can stun creatures many times their size.
A woodpecker whose beak delivers electric shocks. It aggressively pecks at anything shiny or metallic.
A burrowing creature that erupts from the ground in a shower of electric sparks. It headbutts targets with a charged skull.
Tiny bolts arc between its tendrils, energizing allies nearby.
A serpent of pure plasma that moves like living lightning. Its strikes paralyze, and it never stops hunting once it has a target.
A rhinoceros-like beast with a horn that acts as a lightning rod. Its charges are accompanied by deafening thunderclaps.
A floating jellyfish-like creature that drifts through mountain peaks, weaving devastating chain-lightning between its tendrils.
Their coiled tails lash out at anything that dares to cross their path. Always found in groups
The gentle emberfox, found in many homes as a pet. Perfect for winter snuggles
A small flame spirit that actively hunts smaller creatures.
Some say the spirits of lost SiegeKnights burning with rage become pylooks
These scaled lizards are known to have an affinity for lava pools and tracking time
These flying fish dive deep into the lava for obsidian snacks

Hotty, the Fire Eleminion, serves as a bridge between humans and Fire Siegelings, embracing their untamed and passionate nature. It teaches that fire is both a force of creation and destruction, depending on the one who wields it. Those who earn Hotty's trust are said to share an unbreakable bond with their Fire companions.
A salamander with a molten core. These lone siegelings seek the heat of the sun.
These flamming fish swim upstream towards the top of the volcano during eruption season!
Dracoil's leave the safety of the pack to travel alone, but they are known to return when the pack is in danger
The pylook's evolved form, formed on many pylook's fused into a single ghastly creature
The Solgator guards the lava pools of the Fire lands, they attack anything that dares to cross their path"
This ancient Siegeling is said to be the soul of a powerful SiegLord who jumped into the Volcano to become Fire itself
Large and imposing these cuddly creatures only want to find their companion and stay warm.

Falcool is a swift predator of Ele's frozen wilderness, silently stalking prey across the snow. Its massive coat-like wings are lined with thick fur and feathers, shielding it from even the harshest blizzards. When danger approaches, it wraps itself in its wings, disappearing into the icy landscape like a snowdrift.
Bundled up from within the snow, these small deerlike creatures are known to be shy
Frostflies are found fluttering along snowflakes, they rest on pine trees and have a fondness for winter berries
The Ice-Weee is a odd creature, its Ice-Cube shaped body can grow to intimidate other creatures
Trading the puffy for a Hooded Jacker, the Chilldoe has honed its fist into fearsome weapons
A well dressed predator that blends into ice fields. By the time you see it, its talons are already at your throat.

Frosty, the Ice Eleminion, serves as a steadfast bridge between humans and Ice Siegelings. It is said that travelers lost in Ele's frozen wastes often find themselves quietly guided and protected by Frosty. Those who earn its trust gain a companion whose resolve is as unyielding as ice.

Ice-Cue-Wee uses its sturdy kiwi-like beak to punch through frozen lakes in search of fish beneath the ice. Its massive ice-cube head doubles as both armor and a devastating weapon against predators. Few creatures can withstand the force of an Ice-Cue-Wee charging headfirst across the frozen tundra.

Frostag roams Ele's frozen wilderness with unmatched confidence, challenging even the largest predators. Its hardened fists can shatter glaciers and punch straight through ancient permafrost with a single blow. Despite its calm demeanor, few creatures survive provoking a Frostag.

Lumina drift across Ele's frozen deserts like glowing jellyfish, bathing the icy landscape in an ethereal light. Their radiant beauty hides a dangerous power, freezing anything that ventures too close with blasts of bitter cold. Travelers often mistake them for guiding lights, only to discover too late that Lumina are among the tundra's deadliest predators.

Peatbeak are the fashionable icons of Ele's frozen tundra, admired for their oversized goggle-like eyes and luxurious feathered wings. They soar gracefully through icy skies, gathering to perform elegant dances and judged posing competitions. Behind their glamorous appearance are surprisingly agile fliers, capable of weaving through blizzards with effortless precision.

Glaciemperor is the ancient sovereign of Ele's frozen north, said to have carved the first glaciers with the sweep of its crystalline wings. Entire civilizations have vanished beneath the blizzards it commands, yet it awakens only when the balance of the world is threatened. Legends claim every snowflake carries a fragment of its power, waiting for the day its king rises again.
A metallic placeholder Siegeling. Full Metal roster coming soon.

Legends tell of an ancient civilization that sought to create a guardian capable of rivaling the elemental gods. Forged from an unknown metal and powered by an eternal core, Siegebot was their greatest creation.
A mind-touched placeholder Siegeling. Full Psychic roster coming soon.

A mind-touched placeholder Siegeling. Full Psychic roster coming soon.
A powerful placeholder Siegeling. Full Psychic roster coming soon.
Rare capstone of the Undead stand-in line.

Cosmosis, the legendary wielder of the eight primal elements, is said to have emerged when Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind, Water, Poison, Metal, and Electric first converged at the dawn of Ele. Neither bound to a single element nor sworn to the four ancient guardians, Cosmosis commands the forces of creation in perfect harmony, possessing power said to rival even Gos, Mors, Patience, and Penitence.
Shadowy vermin that swarm in dark corners. Individually pathetic, but a pack of them can overwhelm the unprepared.
A bat-like hunter that drops from cave ceilings with razor talons extended. Silent until the moment of impact.
Slips between shadows. You only see it when it wants you to.
Ceeponee flourish among Ele’s vibrant coral reefs. Playful and naturally friendly, they eagerly befriend respectful travelers while fiercely protecting the reefs they call home.

Jawby prowls the deepest waters of Ele, using its massive gills to thrive where few creatures can survive. Though slower on land, it can pursue prey far beyond the shoreline, making nowhere near the coast truly safe.

Shellpack hatch in enormous bales along Ele's sandy shores before instinctively racing toward the sea. Their sturdy shells protect them from predators, and those that survive return as Shellnauts to guard the very beaches where they were born.

The playful Spoutyl can sense sudden rises in temperature from miles away and instinctively rush toward smoke and fire. Though they often mistake campfires for games, this unique instinct has made them beloved partners of Ele's firefighters and rescue teams,

Ceehorcee gains powerful legs that let it race across the ocean’s surface. Playful and fiercely loyal, pods of Ceehorcee travel in perfect synchronization, carrying Valorous Siegeknights through the shallow seas of Ele.
Clawkid gathers in large casts among Ele's reefs and underwater caves. They tirelessly scour the seafloor, consuming fallen flora and fauna alike, leaving pristine reefs in their wake.

Droxyl instinctively rush toward smoke, fearlessly confronting even the fiercest infernos. Their iconic helmets inspired the first human bucket brigades, and they remain beloved partners of Ele's firefighters, builders, and rescue teams, often arriving before anyone else to battle the blaze.

Torqlander's shell evolves into a powerful water jetpack, launching it high above the ocean to escape even the largest predators. Between migrations, playful pods compete to see who can leap the highest, each dreaming of one day touching the Sea of Stars.

Ceesteed serves as the premier war mount of Water Siegeknights. Its powerful legs and wing-like fins let it race across the ocean's surface or cruise effortlessly beneath the waves, making it unmatched in Ele's vast seas.

Clawqueen is the undisputed matriarch of Ele's salt flats and underwater caves. Fiercely territorial, each claims a single cavern, where loyal casts of Clawkid remain close, protecting and maintaining their queen's domain.

Hydroxyl commands Ele's great fire brigades, coordinating rescue efforts wherever flames threaten to spread. Its hose-like arms and tail unleash spinning torrents capable of drenching an entire village square in moments. Though it battles wildfires without hesitation, Hydroxyl holds a deep reverence for fire, believing every element has its rightful place in the balance of Ele.

Jawbite uses its massive jaws and serrated fins to overpower the largest predators of Ele's seas. Feared for its strength yet fiercely loyal, it is often employed to guard merchant convoys and pirate flagships alike.

Shellnaut wields its evolved shell as a powerful water booster, launching devastating rocket-powered headbutts to defend newborn Shellpack. Once the hatchlings safely reach the sea, many ascend toward the Sea of Stars, where legend says the oldest continue their eternal voyage.
Known as the Defender of the Seas, Conchious cultivates the great coral reefs of Ele. Its living reefs shelter countless Water Siegelings, turning barren seafloors into thriving underwater kingdoms.

Breezee travel in great flocks, their synchronized flight creating the cool winds that sweep through the valleys of Ele. Friendly and affectionate, they are among the most common household Siegelings, delighting in warm homes, gentle grooming, and plenty of pampering.

Cloudpuff floats wherever the wind carries it, blending so perfectly with passing clouds that it often goes unnoticed. When danger approaches, it rapidly inflates, casting a shadow large enough to send even fierce predators fleeing.

Despite their adorable appearance, Pursula are notorious thieves throughout Ele. They silently soar from tree to tree using their wing-like ears, stealing eggs, fruit, and anything that sparkles before vanishing without a trace. Many travelers have unknowingly traded with a Pursula only to discover it was selling back their own belongings.

Cloudwisp are playful wind spirits evolved from Cloudpuff, spending their days dancing through the skies of Ele. They weave effortlessly between the clouds, and whenever a cloud seems to bounce, twirl, or drift against the wind, it is said a Cloudwisp is joyfully swaying through its mist.

Gagglestand spends hours balanced motionless on a single leg in the shallow lakes and marshes of Ele, waiting for the perfect moment to spear passing fish with its razor-sharp beak. Their elegant stillness often causes travelers to mistake them for carved statues until they strike with astonishing speed.

Lofty, the Wind Eleminion, is revered as the guardian of the skies and a bridge between humans and Siegelings. It instinctively understands the thoughts and nature of both, often guiding worthy Siegeknights to lifelong companions. Its gentle presence is said to bring calm winds and clear skies wherever it travels.

Purseus is a master thief, using its broad feathered wings to silently raid nests and unattended belongings across Ele. Its razor-sharp claws easily fend off anything brave enough to protect its treasures. As night falls, the crescent antenna atop its head awakens, granting perfect vision in complete darkness.

Shellshock rarely leaves the nest, standing vigil over unhatched eggs under the protection of the great Strikehawk. Hidden within its armored shell, its true form remains one of Ele's greatest mysteries. Any predator foolish enough to test its resolve is met with unwavering defense.

Skydon drifts peacefully through the highest reaches of Ele, watching over the skies from above the clouds. Gentle by nature, it rarely fights unless its domain or allies are threatened. When provoked, it unleashes devastating tornadoes and hurricane-force winds that can scatter entire armies.

Strikehawk rules the skies above Ele, patrolling canyons and forests with unmatched vision. Its missile-like wings allow it to eliminate threats from incredible distances before diving in for the final strike. Feared by predators and revered by many Siegelings, a Strikehawk's shadow alone is often enough to send danger fleeing.

Cloudsprite creates clouds from the moisture in the air, drifting silently across the skies of Ele. Entire rainstorms have been known to follow in its wake, and farmers consider the sight of one a blessing for the coming harvest.

The mighty Hurricrane soars above the clouds where few creatures dare to fly. Each beat of its colossal wings sends roaring gusts across Ele, powerful enough to uproot trees and reshape entire forests. Ancient cultures believed the changing of the seasons began only after the first Hurricrane crossed the sky.

Pursephone is a graceful harpy-like Siegeling renowned for her daring aerial thefts. She raids the nests of rare Siegelings to collect eggs for trade, relying on charm and cunning over brute force. Her iconic style has inspired fashions and festivals celebrating freedom throughout Ele.

Aerovane rarely descends from the upper atmosphere, where it silently circles the world above the clouds. Entire fleets have vanished after challenging the dragon of the skies, swallowed by cyclones conjured with a single beat of its wings. Sailors and Sky Knights alike still offer prayers whenever the winds suddenly fall silent.
